narration: Welcome to the Harappan Civilization & Early Historic India gallery. Here you’ll find a charming terracotta toy cart, accession number HR 13974/222, measuring just 11 centimeters long. This miniature model, crafted around 2500 BCE in Harappa, mirrors the ox‑carts the Harappan people used to move goods and passengers, complete with two wheels on hubs and a bowl‑shaped trolley. It was unearthed by the Archaeological Survey of India and reflects the lively toy‑making tradition of the time, offering a glimpse into everyday life when few full‑size carts survive. Enjoy exploring this tiny but telling piece of ancient India.
